description:
Get your collections (ranked or unranked fragrance lists, such as summer finds or items you saw somewhere). Optionally pass a collectionId to see its items. Free for any signed-in account.

See also: `user_collection_create`, `user_collection_add_item`, `user_collection_remove_item`.

collectionId.description: If given, return items in this collection
